messages:
anya: @here Quick company-wide reminder: Annual privacy & attestation window opens next Monday (Apr 271/271) and runs 5 business days. All headcount must complete the short privacy micro-training and managers must sign the attestation form confirming their team's completions. Link: https://go.redwood/annual-attest-2026 :pushpin:

anya: What we need from managers: one-line manager attestation per direct-report OR a single CSV listing direct-reports + completion timestamp. If someone is on leave, mark "OOO" and indicate expected completion date.

kevin: For remote contractors, do we treat them the same as full-time for attestations?

anya: Yes  contractors included if they're in Okta and appear in headcount. If in doubt, ping people-ops.

sarah.g: I'm on call Apr 27-28. Can I delegate signing to my EM? I have 6 ICs and will attach evidence before the 28th.

anya: Delegation is allowed — use the "delegate" field in the form and include the manager who signed. That keeps the audit trail clean.

devops-bot: Scheduled reminder  DM to all managers on 2026-04-27T09:00Z.

kevin: Any specific artifact requirements for training? Screenshots ok?

anya: Screenshot of completion or LMS cert link is fine. Minimal ask: employee name, training name, completion date, manager. Keep it lightweight.

people-ops-bot: Follow-up check scheduled for 2026-04-29T16:00Z for outstanding attestations.

kevin: I'll batch-upload a CSV for my team tomorrow. Thanks for the heads-up.

anya: Thanks all  please mark exceptions in the form early so we can triage. Audit will sample attestations after the window closes. :eyes:
